story.iWant: 实现全面的收益计算引擎和风险指标分析
story.soThat: 用户能够准确评估单均线策略的风险收益表现和交易绩效
story.tasks:
### Task 1.5.1: 基础收益计算引擎 - [ ] 实现收益率计算函数（单期和累计收益）[AC: 1] - [ ] 实现基于策略信号的仓位价值计算 [AC: 1] - [ ] 支持多种收益计算方法（算术、对数收益） [AC: 1] - [ ] 优化计算性能以处理大量历史数据 [AC: 7]
### Task 1.5.2: 风险指标计算模块 - [ ] 实现最大回撤计算算法 [AC: 2] - [ ] 实现回撤期间识别和统计 [AC: 2] - [ ] 实现波动率和标准差计算 [AC: 2] - [ ] 实现下行风险和上行风险分析 [AC: 2]
### Task 1.5.3: 风险调整收益指标 - [ ] 实现夏普比率计算（含无风险利率调整） [AC: 3] - [ ] 实现Sortino比率计算（聚焦下行风险） [AC: 3] - [ ] 实现信息比率和其他风险调整指标 [AC: 3] - [ ] 支持不同基准的比较分析 [AC: 3]
### Task 1.5.4: 交易统计分析模块 - [ ] 实现胜率计算（盈利交易比例） [AC: 4] - [ ] 实现盈亏比计算（平均盈利/平均亏损） [AC: 4] - [ ] 实现交易频率和持仓时间统计 [AC: 4] - [ ] 实现交易成本和滑点影响分析 [AC: 4]
### Task 1.5.5: 绩效报告生成系统 - [ ] 设计绩效指标数据结构和存储格式 [AC: 5] - [ ] 实现综合绩效报告模板 [AC: 5] - [ ] 支持不同时间维度的绩效分析 [AC: 5] - [ ] 实现绩效对比和基准测试功能 [AC: 5]
### Task 1.5.6: API接口和数据服务 - [ ] 实现收益计算API端点 [AC: 7] - [ ] 实现绩效指标查询API [AC: 7] - [ ] 实现历史绩效数据缓存机制 [AC: 7] - [ ] 集成错误处理和参数验证 [AC: 7]
### Task 1.5.7: 测试和验证框架 - [ ] 编写收益计算单元测试（包含边界情况） [AC: 1-7] - [ ] 编写风险指标计算准确性测试 [AC: 1-7] - [ ] 编写API接口集成测试 [AC: 1-7] - [ ] 创建性能验证和压力测试 [AC: 1-7]

story-context.acceptanceCriteria: 1. 计算策略收益率和累计收益（支持算术和对数收益计算） 2. 计算最大回撤和回撤期间分析（识别回撤起止时间和深度） 3. 计算夏普比率和Sortino比率（包含无风险利率调整） 4. 计算胜率和盈亏比（交易统计和成本分析） 5. 提供详细的交易记录统计和绩效报告生成 6. 集成前序故事的策略信号数据进行准确计算 7. 提供标准化的API接口供前端调用和可视化展示

doc.title: Technical Specification
doc.snippet: PerformanceMetrics model with total_return, max_drawdown, sharpe_ratio fields. Risk-adjusted return calculations and API endpoints for backtest functionality.

doc.title: Epic 1 Technical Context
doc.snippet: Data flow: AKShare API → DataProcessor → Strategy Engine → Performance Analytics. Integration points between strategy signals and performance calculations.

doc.title: Decision Architecture
doc.snippet: Unified error handling with {success, data, message} response format. RESTful API design with OpenAPI 3.0 specification. Caching strategies using Redis + SQLite.

doc.title: Story 1.4 Implementation Details
doc.snippet: Strategy engine provides complete signal generation and trading execution functionality. Vectorized computation and caching mechanisms established for performance optimization.

artifact.reason: Contains trade statistics (total_trades, winning_trades, losing_trades) that feed into performance calculations
Existing backtest result structure with performance metrics (total_return, win_rate, profit_factor) to be enhanced
Core market data model providing price data (open, high, low, close) required for return calculations
Existing API pattern and response structure to be followed for performance endpoints

constraints.constraint: Must follow existing API response format: {success: boolean, data: object, message: string}
Performance calculations must integrate with existing strategy signal data structures
Use established caching pattern: Redis for temporary results (1-24h TTL), SQLite for persistent storage
Implement vectorized calculations using NumPy for performance optimization
Follow established file structure: backend/app/services/performance/ for new modules
Use Pydantic models for API validation and SQLAlchemy for database models
All calculations must handle large datasets (>10,000 data points) efficiently
Error messages must be user-friendly and in Chinese as per communication language setting

interface.name: StrategyEngine Integration
interface.signature: def calculate_performance_metrics(signals: List[Signal], prices: List[float]) -> PerformanceMetrics

tests.standards: Use pytest with pytest-asyncio for async testing. Test coverage target >80%. Follow existing pattern: unit tests in backend/tests/strategy/ directory. Use parametrized tests for multiple calculation scenarios. Include edge cases (empty data, single data point, extreme values).

ideas.test: test_return_calculation_accuracy - Verify simple and log return calculations against known values
test_max_drawdown_calculation - Test drawdown detection with synthetic peak/valley data
test_trading_statistics - Test win rate and profit/loss ratio calculations
test_performance_report_generation - Verify report structure and content
test_api_integration - Test performance API endpoints with real strategy data
test_large_dataset_performance - Stress test with >50k data points
